cd /workspace/tests && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='reference.py'
s=open(p).read()
start = s.index("            elif head == 'repartition':")
end = s.index("            elif head == 'cancel':")
new = '''            elif head == 'repartition':
                new = cmd[1]
                old = self.borders
                Rn = len(new) - 1

                def project(vec):
                    out = [0] * Rn
                    for idx in range(len(vec)):
                        m = vec[idx]
                        if not m:
                            continue
                        b = old[idx]
                        span = old[idx + 1] - b
                        for j in range(Rn):
                            u, v = new[j], new[j + 1]
                            hi = min(max(v - b, 0), span)
                            lo = min(max(u - b, 0), span)
                            out[j] += (m * hi) // span - (m * lo) // span
                    return out

                self.C = [[project(self.C[l][q]) for q in range(self.M)] for l in range(self.L)]
                self.H = project(self.H)
                self.borders = list(new)
                log.append([i, 'repartition', Rn])
'''
s = s[:start] + new + s[end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
